bot_tasks.name: Market Intelligence Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Research audience segments, pain points, competitors, keywords, and demand signals.

bot_tasks.name: Strategy Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Translate research into channel strategy, positioning, offers, and campaign plans.

bot_tasks.name: Content Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Write long-form posts, landing pages, email sequences, social posts, and scripts.

bot_tasks.name: SEO Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Optimize topics, structure, internal linking, metadata, schema, and search intent.

bot_tasks.name: Distribution Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Repurpose content for LinkedIn, X, email, blog, and short-form channels.

bot_tasks.name: Lead Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Create lead magnets, funnels, CTAs, nurture sequences, and qualification logic.

bot_tasks.name: Analytics Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Track performance, attribution, CTR, conversion, retention, and pipeline impact.

bot_tasks.name: Optimization Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Run experiments, compare variants, identify bottlenecks, and recommend next action.

bot_tasks.name: Compliance Bot
bot_tasks.responsibility: Check brand voice, factual accuracy, legal risk, and policy constraints.

campaign.campaign_objective: Launch ClearGlass Marketing OS for premium B2B demand generation
campaign.target_audience: cybersecurity, AI, OSINT, and software leaders

channel_plan.website: Publish a technical pillar page with proof, CTAs, FAQ schema, and internal links.
channel_plan.linkedin: Run executive posts, carousel summaries, and founder-led proof narratives.
channel_plan.x: Ship concise technical threads with one claim, one proof point, and one CTA per post.
channel_plan.email: Send a three-email sequence: problem framing, proof, and consultation CTA.
channel_plan.partners: Package the campaign as a partner briefing for cybersecurity, AI, and OSINT channels.

campaign.hook_and_message_angle: multi-agent marketing command systems: the hidden operating gap costing cybersecurity, AI, OSINT, and software leaders speed, trust, and revenue
publishing_sequence: Day 1: publish pillar page and analytics events
Day 2: post LinkedIn thesis and X thread
Day 3: send email 1 and launch lead magnet
Day 4: publish carousel and partner briefing
Day 5: send email 2 and review click/conversion data
Day 7: send email 3 and produce optimization report
risks_and_constraints: Do not claim unverified platform capabilities or customer outcomes.
Escalate legal, regulated-security, or attribution claims to Compliance Bot.
Separate authority metrics from revenue metrics in reporting.
experiment_plan: A/B test contrarian vs. risk-reduction hooks on LinkedIn.
A/B test checklist CTA vs. executive briefing CTA on the landing page.
Compare technical proof-led email subject lines against pain-led subject lines.
weekly_review_and_optimization_recommend: Promote channels that generate qualified conversations, not raw impressions.
Move winning hooks into shared memory and retire losing variants.
Convert objections from sales calls into FAQ, email, and retargeting assets.
